t: Din birkat "asher yatzar" kol hayyom achar hatalat mayim.
s: Din birkat "asher yatzar" kol hayyom achar hatalat mayim. Ubo z' seipim: kol hayyom kesheoseh tzerakayv ben qetannim ben gedolim — mebarek "asher yatzar", abal en tzarik lebarek "al netilat yadayim", apillu hayu yadayv meluklakot sheshshipshep bahem o qinnach bahem, vaapillu rotzeh lilmod o lehitpallel miyyad. Veap-al-pi shei-epshar lo lehitpallel ella im ken natal yadayv bemayim, im yesh lo mayim — mikkol maqom, lo tiqqenu chakamim lebarek al hannetila ella bashshachar, mishshum denaaseh kibriyya chadasha, ukemo shennitbaer besiman d, ubintilat yadayim laakila mishshum serek teruma:

Hammetil mayim velo shipshep, im nizhar shello ligga beervato — en tzarik littol yadayv kelal, apillu im rotzeh lehitpallel miyyad. Mikkol maqom, nakon haddabar sheyyirchotz yadayv qodem sheyyilmod o sheyyizkor et hashshem, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon liqrat eloheka yisrael":

Mi shehetil mayim veshakach lebarek "asher yatzar", ap-al-pi shehissiach dato millehatil od mayim veachar-kak nimlak vehetil od mayim, apillu hake — eno tzarik lebarek shette peamim "asher yatzar", ella mebarek paam achat, veoleh lo ap lemah shehetil battechilla. Ha lemah zeh domeh, lemi sheakal vehissiach dato milleekol od veshakach velo berak birkat hammazon, veachar-kak nimlak vechazar veakal — sheeno tzarik lebarek birkat hammazon shette peamim, ella paam achat, veoleh lo ap lemah sheakal battechilla:

En shiur lahatalat mayim, ki apillu letippa achat chayyab lebarek, sheim yissatem hanneqeb millehotzi hattippa hahi — haya qasheh lo, vechayyab lehodot. Velaken kesheadam rotzeh lelek lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel, o holek leekol, ubodeq et atzmo shemma yitztarek linqabayv umetaptep meat — tzarik lebarek "asher yatzar", kevan shenniptechu neqabayv:
Lo yomar: "rope choli kol basar", ella "rope kol basar":

Mi sheshshoteh sam hamshalshel ubedato lepannot habbene meayim ad shettikleh hazzuhama mehem, kevan shello hissiach dato measiyyat tzerakayv, lepikak lo yebarek "asher yatzar" ad achar gemar hahotzaa:

Mi sheakal dabar shetztzarik lebarek beraka acharona veshakach velo berak, vehetil mayim, venizkar qodem shebberak "asher yatzar" — yebarek techilla "asher yatzar", veachar-kak habberaka haacharona, mippene shettadir qodem lesheeno tadir:
